description: We are building a six-storey apartment with eighteen units and two contiguous scissors stairs. The wall between the stairs is rated. The team wants a self-closing rated crossover door through that wall at every second landing to simplify access. The doors would connect the two exit stairs directly.
known_facts: crossover doorways directly between stairs proposed
